Initial release — 30-day milestone-driven countdown for QSR audit readiness.

- Guides operators through structured audit prep starting 30 days out, with prompts and checklists for each critical milestone (Day -30, -21, -14, -7, -1).
- Stores progress using a clear memory format for milestone status, findings, and corrective actions.
- Incorporates previous audit findings and custom audit criteria if available.
- Provides focused training, team communication, and full-store walkthrough protocols.
- Designed for use with any third-party compliance audit (EcoSure, health department, corporate, franchise).
